input_set_rule: The eight files in consumed_inputs were copied, and only those files were present in each fresh clean build directory before the declared TeX/BibTeX passes. No historical source, remote snapshot, figure, dataset, experiment artifact, or ambient project TeX file is an input.

toolchain.container: No container was used. The exact local TeX Live/pdfTeX/BibTeX versions and deterministic environment variables are recorded because these are the compiler inputs used for the archived artifact.

controlled_build.command: For each fresh directory containing only the eight declared inputs: env SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1789948800 TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -file-line-error paper.tex; env SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1789948800 TZ=UTC LC_ALL=C bibtex paper; then run the same pdflatex command twice more.

output.creator: LaTeX with hyperref
output.visual_inspection: All five pages rendered at 144 dpi and inspected: title, theorem blocks, compact scope matrix, references, appendix checklist, and AI-use statement are legible with no clipping, overlap, or broken hierarchy.

citation_gate.reconciliation: The active citekey set exactly matches citation_lock.json's active_revision_02_citation_keys. closest_work_matrix.md now has no pending-lock status and explicitly separates matrix-only contextual sources.

known_limits: This controlled local build establishes deterministic reproduction under the declared TeX Live 2026/macOS environment; it is not a claim of cross-platform byte identity.
The active paper is theory-only and does not restore public-baseline empirical evidence.
No theorem-level novelty distinction from direct antecedents, nontrivial unifying theorem, or new empirical evidence is present.
